apps.name: grav
apps.label: Grav
apps.description: A flat-file CMS. Pages are Markdown files in the site directory, so there is no database, no schema and nothing to migrate.

apps.name: joomla
apps.label: Joomla
apps.description: The second CMS most of the web runs on. Servlo creates the database and the account scoped to it; Joomla's own installer finishes.

apps.name: wordpress
apps.label: WordPress
apps.description: The content manager most of the web runs on. Installs with its own database, a generated admin account, and a real system cron.
